subject: Provisional PO issuance & line-item scrub for Acme Logistics onboarding
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Harper <liam.harper@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisional PO issuance & line-item scrub for Acme Logistics onboarding

Hi Liam,

Great to e-meet — thanks for sending the onboarding packet yesterday. We're ready to issue a provisional PO so your team can hit the initial kickoff milestones, but before we issue the PO number we need to confirm two quick items:

1) Spend cap allocation: Our standard onboarding provisional cap is $25,000 USD unless a different amount was negotiated. Please confirm the expected first-quarter spend breakdown by category (setup, data ingress, seats).

2) Line items / SKU mapping: The onboarding form you sent lists three line items but they don't match our internal SKU mapping. I've attached a provisional_po_request.xlsx that shows the Redwoods SKUs we expect to map — can you review and confirm which of Acme's service codes map to the rows in column B?

If those two items look good I can request a provisional PO number from Finance and route it back to you (with a note that it is provisional and subject to adjustment during PO finalization). Targeting to have a provisional number by Monday EOD if we get confirmation today.

Attachments: acme_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (completed onboarding questionnaire), provisional_po_request.xlsx (proposed SKU mapping)

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@acmelogistics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional PO issuance & line-item scrub for Acme Logistics onboarding

Hi Monica — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers below:

1) Spend cap: We confirm a provisional onboarding spend of $27,500 to cover an extra data normalization pass we discussed. Breakdown: setup $10,000; data ingress $12,500; seats $5,000.

2) SKU mapping: Reviewed your spreadsheet. Two of our internal codes (ACME-SVC-44 and ACME-SVC-47) map to your "data ingress" row but we also have an internal split for "ETL - small/large files" that you'd need as separate line items. We attached a redline of your sheet back as acme_onboarding_form_v2 (see annotation).

We are OK with a provisional PO number; please mark it provisional and include the $27.5k cap. We'll follow up with a final SOW that may reallocate up to 10% between setup and data ingress.

Forwarding to our procurement mailbox to make sure the formal PO paperwork matches.

Best,
Liam

Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional PO issuance & line-item scrub for Acme Logistics onboarding

Monica —

Thanks, this is straightforward. Finance can issue a provisional PO (prefixed P-ONB) but asks for two things before issuance:

- Final confirmed cap in USD (per vendor confirmation, $27,500 is ok).
- A single canonical invoice remit address for the PO and the legal entity name to appear on the PO (we need the exact legal entity string that will appear on invoices).

Connor, can you pull the vendor record and confirm whether Acme has previously set up a remit address or legal name in our supplier registry? If not, we'll need Liam to provide it (legal name + W-9 equivalent for US suppliers).

If we have the remit name today Finance will issue provisional PO P-ONB-20260413-003 and I'll route the PDF to Liam and procurement@acmelogistics.com.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Vendor Activation Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

All — quick update after checking the supplier registry:

- We do not yet have a canonical remit address or legal entity for Acme Logistics. The entry in the registry is a placeholder created during the initial talk.
- Liam sent the requested details via separate email at 14:42 (legal name: Acme Logistics, Inc.; remit: Accounts Payable, 300 Harbor Way, Suite 210, Oakland, CA 94607; tax id provided redacted in-thread).

Next steps: Ben — if you can confirm Finance is OK to issue a provisional PO with the remit details above I'll mark the record as "provisionally active" and finalize the SKU/line-item split as follows:
  - Setup: ACME-SVC-12 (10,000)
  - ETL - small files: ACME-SVC-44 (7,500)
  - ETL - large files: ACME-SVC-47 (5,000)
  - Seats: ACME-SVC-03 (5,000)

I'll attach the cleaned onboarding form to the vendor record once Ben confirms.

Connor
